label: Math Solving
description: Solve a math problem with steps and final result.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for calculation, proof, algebra, statistics, or quantitative solution.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for financial advice rather than math.

label: Math Verification
description: Check a calculation, proof, derivation, or quantitative claim.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a mathematical solution is correct.

label: Mathematical Modeling
description: Build or critique a mathematical, statistical, or optimization model.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to model a process, estimate relationship, or formulate constraints.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for qualitative brainstorming only.

label: Math Explanation
description: Explain mathematical concepts, steps, or intuition.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to understand math rather than only get an answer.

label: Statistical Analysis
description: Analyze statistical results, distributions, uncertainty, or significance.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for scientific method critique only.

label: Optimization
description: Formulate or solve optimization problems and constraints.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to maximize, minimize, or optimize.
User asks for proof or rigorous derivation.

label: Simulation Planning
description: Plan simulations, assumptions, variables, and outputs.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to simulate a system.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to run production deployment.

label: Error Checking
description: Check arithmetic, formulas, calculations, and numerical consistency.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to check math for mistakes.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for prose editing only.
